supported_scope: Approval checkpoints for write, bash, web tools, and code artifact writes with interactive prompts and review modes
unestablished_scope: Approval requirements for non-standard or third-party tools beyond native mechanisms
Bypass mechanisms outside sandbox mode and toolPermission settings
Mode-specific exceptions beyond default and plan modes
required_setup: Default configuration uses 'request-review' toolPermission and 'asks-for-review' artifactReviewPolicy; sandbox mode optional and configurable
constraints: Actions not explicitly allowed or denied default to Ask mode requiring approval
Workspace file reads/writes auto-allowed unless overridden
Sandbox mode affects approval prompts and command execution containment
Plan mode prepends /plan prefix and uses read-only tools before approval

evidence.section: Agent permissions > Antigravity CLI > Default CLI system behaviors and guardrails
evidence.quote: When an action isn’t explicitly listed in your allow , deny , or ask lists, the system falls back to secure system defaults: ... Web browsing defaults to Ask : Actions for read_url and execute_url default to Ask . Before the agent navigates to or actuates on any web page, it pauses and prompts for your approval unless an allow rule is configured.
evidence.claim: Unconfigured actions default to Ask requiring approval before execution

evidence.section: Settings > Antigravity CLI > Configuration options reference > Safety and permissions
evidence.quote: Tool Permission ( toolPermission ) : Controls the authorization flow for tools (such as running terminal commands): request-review (default): Prompts for your approval before running write, bash, or web tools.
evidence.claim: Default toolPermission setting enforces approval prompts for write, bash, and web tools

evidence.section: Choose an execution mode > Review modifications in default mode
evidence.quote: In default mode ( request-review ), Antigravity CLI pauses before applying any file writes to disk and renders an inline, syntax-highlighted diff preview.
evidence.claim: Default mode pauses for user approval before file writes

evidence.quote: When the sandbox is enabled : The confirmation prompt includes a specific option to Yes, and run without sandbox restrictions if you need to temporarily bypass the containment boundary for a single trusted command.
evidence.claim: Sandbox mode affects approval prompts and allows temporary bypass with explicit user consent
